experience.title: Work Experience
experience.bullet1: Architected a production <1>HLS system</1> with a local proxy server, buffer-aware grace timer, and 4-phase offline recovery — ensuring uninterrupted playback on unstable networks.
experience.bullet2: Built a video player <1>object pool</1> with epoch-based concurrency, debounced prefetch, and platform-adaptive sizing (iOS/Android) — delivering frame-ready playback on every swipe.
experience.bullet3: Decomposed a large multi-concern controller into focused, independently testable units via <1>mixin composition</1>, each owning a single responsibility (state, lifecycle, events, network).
experience.bullet4: Implemented a custom <1>async semaphore + generation-guard</1> pattern to eliminate race conditions during rapid swiping, preventing native-layer crashes from stale init tasks.
experience.bullet5: Built an <1>offline-first progress tracker</1> with local persistence, batch sync (≤10/session), exponential-backoff retry, and atomic read/write — zero data loss on sudden app termination.
experience.bullet6: Engineered a <1>multi-layer RAM cache</1> with explicit eviction and bounded collections to reduce GC pressure and prevent OOM errors in long video sessions.
experience.bullet7: Designed a <1>navigation-stack-based playback coordinator</1> that propagates interaction state (like, save, comment, view count) across all active screens via snapshot-safe iteration.
experience.bullet8: Integrated an <1>ABR engine</1> with EWMA bandwidth estimation and quality capping during preload — preventing bandwidth contention between active playback and background prefetch.
experience.bullet9: Applied <1>Clean Architecture</1> (data / domain / presentation) with interface-driven design and GetX-based dependency injection across all feature modules.

projects.title: Featured Projects
projects.p1Desc: A TikTok-style short-video learning platform with HLS adaptive streaming, offline progress tracking, and a continuous-scroll feed for educational content.
projects.p1B1: <1>Video Architecture:</1> Epoch-based object pool + debounced prefetch + warm-up pre-init — video is frame-ready the moment the user finishes swiping.
projects.p1B2: <1>Network Resilience:</1> 4-phase offline recovery with buffer-aware grace timer (3s-60s), early buffer-drain detection, and auto-resume at the correct playback position on reconnect.
projects.p1B3: <1>Local Proxy & Cache:</1> HLS proxy server with multi-layer cache (in-memory + disk), lazy playlist rebuild from downloaded segments, and bounded disk eviction.
projects.p1B4: <1>Adaptive Bitrate:</1> EWMA bandwidth estimation + network-type safety factors + quality capping during preload — eliminates quality thrashing under fluctuating connections.
projects.p1B5: <1>Offline Tracking:</1> Batch sync, exponential-backoff retry, atomic read/write, and checkpoint fallback to handle edge cases where the player resets position to zero while offline.
projects.p1B6: <1>Global State:</1> Navigation-stack coordinator propagates like/save/comment/view count updates to all active screens simultaneously via snapshot-safe iteration.

click-ed.title: CLICK-Ed
click-ed.subtitle: Multi-Channel Educational Social Network & Optimized Short-Video Platform
click-ed.overview: CLICK-Ed is a comprehensive, multi-channel educational social network integrating a Q&A platform, professional e-Learning system, live streaming, and a high-engagement short-video experience. It features advanced modules like E-Wallet & Monetization, an AI ChatBot, an educational Marketplace, and a fully featured social interaction layer.
click-ed.challenge: The short-video module represents extreme technical complexity, mirroring architectures like TikTok. The primary challenges involved eliminating UI jank, preventing memory leaks, and optimizing playback smoothness over unstable or slow mobile network conditions.
click-ed.solution: I engineered a Local HTTP Proxy Server using shelf on-device for CDN token injection and progressive caching. Developed a custom Video Player Pool Manager via GetX with active memory pressure recycling. Orchestrated an intelligent preloading system leveraging Epoch Tracking, Cooperative Bandwidth Allocation, Network-Aware optimization, and dynamic Adaptive Bitrate (ABR) streaming.
features: Comprehensive Q&A and e-Learning ecosystem with AI ChatBot support
Local HTTP Proxy Server architecture for Progressive HLS Segment Caching
Video Player Pool Manager for controller recycling & active memory release
Advanced Preload Orchestration using Epoch Tracking & Cooperative Bandwidth
Network-Aware Adaptive Bitrate (ABR) optimization & CPU Yielding
In-app E-Wallet, membership subscriptions, and educational Marketplace

mydtu.title: MYDTU MOBILE APP
mydtu.subtitle: Super App - Multifunctional Integration Portal & Real-Time Synchronization
mydtu.overview: MyDTU is a Super App – a multifunctional integrated portal serving tens of thousands of students and faculty members at Duy Tan University. The application comprehensively synchronizes academic management, teaching schedules, multi-tiered profile lookups, financial tracking, and personal calendars in real-time, featuring a dynamic role-based authorization system that adapts automatically to user personas.
mydtu.challenge: The primary challenges involved dealing with highly complex data input forms (multi-tiered profiles) causing user friction, securing API transmission channels against unauthorized manipulation, and engineering local search mechanisms across massive data blocks without introducing UI jank.
mydtu.solution: I developed a Form Automation Mixin (ScrollToError) and ExpandController to streamline complex input workflows. For network security, I enforced Triple DES (3DES - ECB - PKCS7) with MD5 hashing for Header Signature Tokens. Furthermore, I architected a Zero Lag Local Search Algorithm utilizing Debouncing and Diacritics Removal, supported by a Centralized Dio Client optimized via concurrency with Future.wait.
features: Multi-tiered profile management & parallel dependent province/district selectors
Comprehensive Academic Management for students (Registration, Transcripts, Fees)
Advanced Teaching Management for lecturers (Class roster, Grades, Schedule swaps)
Dynamic Role-Based System adapting layout and menus based on user permission level
Anti-tampering security via 3DES encryption & MD5 Signature Token in API headers
Timezone-Aware Notifications engine for precise, localized academic scheduling

linkeep.title: Linkeep
linkeep.subtitle: Premium Digital Curator & High-Performance Link Manager
linkeep.overview: A premium cross-platform mobile application (Android & iOS) designed as a 'Digital Curator' to help users manage, categorize, and optimize their bookmark experience with ultra-high performance, biometric security, and offline-first synchronization.
linkeep.challenge: Minimizing query latency when handling thousands of link records and performing real-time searches, while ensuring completely smooth and robust data synchronization in unstable network environments.
linkeep.solution: I architected a 2-Layer Hybrid Cache (Write-Through Caching) system merging SQLite with an In-memory Reactive Cache for 0ms responsiveness. I implemented a SessionSyncService utilizing an In-memory Queue serialized to GetStorage for automatic, resilient background sync. Additionally, I engineered an advanced internal Ad-Blocker via JS DOM Removal inside InAppWebView, and leveraged deep OS integration (Receive Intent) for seamless, instant share sheet capturing.
features: High-End Dark Mode design system using Tonal Layering & Glassmorphism
Smart Content Aggregator with automatic Open Graph scraping & auto-categorization
Advanced Web Viewer with internal Ad-Blocker using JS DOM Removal
Dual-Layer Security: Biometric Authentication (Local Auth) & dynamic secure PIN
Deep OS integration via Receive Intent to capture links directly from the Share Sheet

realjobs.title: RealJobs
realjobs.subtitle: Mobile Recruitment & Educational Connections Ecosystem
realjobs.overview: RealJobs is a comprehensive recruitment and educational ecosystem tailored for iOS & Android. It serves as a multi-dimensional bridge between Employers, Students/Candidates, Universities/Instructors, and Alumni. The platform handles the entire lifecycle from job searches and internships to interview scheduling, academic evaluations, and corporate HR management.
realjobs.challenge: The key challenges included developing, testing, and managing an extremely large-scale app with 60+ independent screen modules and complex role-based authorization. It required high network resilience, robust multi-environment configuration, and strict security protocols.
realjobs.solution: I implemented Modular Clean Architecture & GetX for robust, scalable application structures. Configured four distinct environments (Dev/STG/Test/Prod) via flutter_flavorizr. Built custom AuthInterceptors paired with connectivity_plus for network resiliency and offline safety checks. Leveraged secure API Payload Signatures, custom HTML editors, and refined UX through custom shimmer effects.
features: Dynamic Multi-role Ecosystem with distinct, access-controlled interfaces
Advanced Job & Recruitment Management with multi-format CV support and batch approvals
End-to-End Internship Ecosystem digitalizing 3-way evaluation workflows (Uni-Employer-Student)
Smart Interview & Slot Scheduler integrated with recruitment event feeds
Multi-channel Communications featuring in-app messaging, emails, and activity logging
Highly scalable Modular Clean Architecture with 60+ production-grade screen modules

food-quest.title: FoodQuest
food-quest.subtitle: Interactive Food Discovery & Multi-flavor Social Dining Platform
food-quest.overview: FoodQuest is an interactive food discovery mobile application designed to help users search, discover, and share local culinary experiences. Integrated with a Firebase backend, the app features real-time geolocation matching, social sharing feeds, and customized user preference profiles.
food-quest.challenge: Building a clean, multi-flavor system to easily deploy different versions (Dev, Staging, Production) without mixing up credentials or configuration. Also, optimizing geographic map queries and ensuring smooth rendering of high-resolution food images in scrollable feeds.
food-quest.solution: I architected the project using FVM for stable Flutter version control and configured multi-flavor environments using distinct Firebase configurations. Integrated Google Maps API with cached geofencing search and built a robust image caching pipeline to guarantee stutter-free feed scrolling.
features: Multi-flavor configuration (Development, Staging, Production environments)
Robust Firebase authentication & real-time Cloud Firestore synchronization
Interactive food location discovery utilizing geolocator & Google Maps API
Sleek social dining feeds with asynchronous local image caching
FVM (Flutter Version Manager) configuration for absolute pipeline consistency

bookara.title: Bookara
bookara.subtitle: Premium Comic & Novel Reader with Hybrid Offline Storage
bookara.overview: Bookara (reading_app) is a high-performance, modern reader application tailored for comic enthusiasts and novel readers. Built with an offline-first architecture, the application delivers a seamless experience with instant content loading, bookmarks, customized reader themes, and smooth transitions.
bookara.challenge: Rendering large quantities of high-resolution comic images and rich HTML novel content without triggering memory leaks or frame drops. Maintaining completely offline functionality with seamless background synchronization of bookmarks when back online.
bookara.solution: I utilized GetX for reactive state management and structured the app with robust local storage using Sqflite. Integrated Dio with custom interceptors for resilient API pre-fetching and caching, and developed a custom HTML parser to render rich novel text flawlessly.
features: Dual-engine reader supporting both high-res comic images and rich HTML novels
GetX reactive architecture with modular bindings for dependency injection
Robust SQLite (Sqflite) offline storage for book library and bookmarks tracking
Dio-powered network layer with automated caching & retry interceptors
Customizable reading styles (Night mode, reader themes, custom typography)

auto-fin.title: AutoFin
auto-fin.subtitle: Personal Finance Tracker & Smart Automation Workflows
auto-fin.overview: AutoFin is an intelligent utility application designed to simplify personal finance tracking through automation. It enables users to record transactions, schedule financial workflows, visualize spending habits, and securely export data for accounting.
auto-fin.challenge: Structuring complex automation workflows that execute efficiently on a mobile device and ensuring maximum privacy and security for sensitive financial data stored locally.
auto-fin.solution: Designed a custom automation scheduler that executes background checks and localized notifications. Secured sensitive records with an encrypted SQLite database and used GetX to ensure lightweight, zero-lag UI interactions.
features: Smart personal finance logging with custom category tagging
Automated recurring transaction scheduler and background alert engine
Interactive analytical charts showing real-time monthly budget metrics
Secure local-first database with direct export capabilities (CSV / Excel format)
Modular architecture designed for rapid future API banking integrations
